  "data": "flowchart LR
    %% Styling
    classDef actor fill:#f5f5f5,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px,shape:circle;
    classDef usecase fill:#e8f4f8,stroke:#0288d1,stroke-width:2px,rx:20,ry:20;

    %% Actors (Outside System Boundary)
    Worker(("Informal Worker")):::actor
    Manager(("Fund Manager")):::actor
    Regulator(("RBA Regulator")):::actor
    Admin(("System Administrator")):::actor

    %% System Boundary
    subgraph MicoPesaSystem ["MicoPesa System Boundary"]
        direction TB
        
        %% Universal / Shared
        UC_Login(["Login"]):::usecase
        UC_Notif(["Receive Notifications"]):::usecase
        
        %% Worker Specific Use Cases
        UC_Reg(["Register & Verify Account"]):::usecase
        UC_KYC(["KYC Identity Verification"]):::usecase
        UC_Contrib(["Make Micro-Contribution"]):::usecase
        UC_Chan(["Choose Contribution Channel"]):::usecase
        UC_Plan(["Create / Update Retirement Plan"]):::usecase
        UC_Bal(["View Balance & Contribution History"]):::usecase
        UC_Proj(["View Retirement Projection"]):::usecase
        UC_Lit(["Access Financial Literacy & Tips"]):::usecase
        UC_Claim(["Submit Withdrawal Claim"]):::usecase
        UC_Elig(["Check Claim Eligibility"]):::usecase
        
        %% Includes for Worker
        UC_Reg -.->|"<<include>>"| UC_KYC
        UC_Contrib -.->|"<<include>>"| UC_Chan
        UC_Claim -.->|"<<include>>"| UC_Elig
        
        %% Fund Manager Use Cases
        UC_Approve(["Review & Approve Withdrawal Claims"]):::usecase
        UC_GenRep(["Generate RBA / NSSF Reports"]):::usecase
        UC_MgFund(["Manage Fund Performance"]):::usecase

        %% Fund Manager & RBA Regulator Shared Use Cases
        UC_AuditFundComp(["Audit Fund Performance & Compliance"]):::usecase
        UC_ViewRep(["View Compliance Reports"]):::usecase
        UC_AuditOps(["Review Operational Audit Logs"]):::usecase

        %% System Administrator Use Cases
        UC_MgUsers(["Manage Users"]):::usecase
        UC_MgRoles(["Manage Roles & Permissions"]):::usecase
        UC_MgConfig(["Manage System Configuration"]):::usecase
        UC_MgNotif(["Manage System Notifications"]):::usecase
        UC_MonActivity(["Monitor System Activity"]):::usecase
        UC_AuditSys(["Review System Audit Logs"]):::usecase
    end

    %% Shared Associations (The "Spiderweb")
    Worker --- UC_Login
    Manager --- UC_Login
    Regulator --- UC_Login
    Admin --- UC_Login
    
    Worker --- UC_Notif
    Manager --- UC_Notif

    %% Informal Worker Associations
    Worker --- UC_Reg
    Worker --- UC_Contrib
    Worker --- UC_Plan
    Worker --- UC_Bal
    Worker --- UC_Proj
    Worker --- UC_Lit
    Worker --- UC_Claim

    %% Fund Manager Associations
    Manager --- UC_Approve
    Manager --- UC_GenRep
    Manager --- UC_MgFund
    Manager --- UC_AuditFundComp
    Manager --- UC_ViewRep
    Manager --- UC_AuditOps

    %% RBA Regulator Associations
    Regulator --- UC_AuditFundComp
    Regulator --- UC_ViewRep
    Regulator --- UC_AuditOps

    %% System Administrator Associations
    %% NOTE: Admin is intentionally NOT connected to UC_Approve, UC_GenRep,
    %% or UC_ViewRep - the Administrator manages the platform but does not
    %% approve withdrawals or perform RBA regulatory oversight.
    Admin --- UC_MgUsers
    Admin --- UC_MgRoles
    Admin --- UC_MgConfig
    Admin --- UC_MgNotif
    Admin --- UC_MonActivity
    Admin --- UC_AuditSys",
  "config": null
}

    %% 1. Peripheral Nodes (Routed safely away from the core)
    USER "1" --> "1" KYC_RECORD : has
    USER "1" --> "0..*" USSD_SESSION : initiates
    USER "1" --> "0..*" NOTIFICATION : receives
    USER "1" --> "0..*" AUDIT_LOG : generates

    %% 2. Core Hierarchy Branch
    USER "1" --> "1" PENSION_ACCOUNT : owns

    PENSION_ACCOUNT "1" --> "0..*" RETIREMENT_PLAN : creates
    RETIREMENT_PLAN "1" --> "0..*" RETIREMENT_PROJECTION : generates

    %% 3. Funding and Allocations Branch
    FUND "1" --> "0..*" FUND_ALLOCATION : assigned to
    PENSION_ACCOUNT "1" --> "0..*" FUND_ALLOCATION : has

    %% 4. Transactional Flow Branch
    PENSION_ACCOUNT "1" --> "0..*" CONTRIBUTION : makes
    CONTRIBUTION "1" --> "1" TRANSACTION : recorded as

    PENSION_ACCOUNT "1" --> "0..*" WITHDRAWAL_CLAIM : submits
    USER "0..1" --> "0..*" WITHDRAWAL_CLAIM : reviews

    %% 5. Broad/Reporting Dependencies (Grouped at the bottom to prevent crossing upwards)
    USER "1" --> "0..*" COMPLIANCE_REPORT : generates
    
    COMPLIANCE_REPORT "0..*" ..> "0..*" CONTRIBUTION : summarizes
    COMPLIANCE_REPORT "0..*" ..> "0..*" WITHDRAWAL_CLAIM : summarizes
    COMPLIANCE_REPORT "0..*" ..> "0..*" FUND_ALLOCATION : reports on

    %% Administrator-managed platform configuration
    USER "0..1" --> "0..*" SYSTEM_SETTINGS : updates",
  "config": null
}

  "data": "---
title: MicoPesa - Registration and KYC Verification Sequence Diagram
---
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber

    actor Worker as Informal Worker
    participant PWA as React PWA / USSD
    participant API as Express API
    participant DB as PostgreSQL Database
    participant IPRS as IPRS / Government ID API

    Worker->>PWA: Submit registration details
    activate PWA

    PWA->>API: POST /api/v1/auth/register
    activate API

    API->>IPRS: Verify National ID and data match
    activate IPRS

    IPRS-->>API: Verification response
    deactivate IPRS

    alt Valid citizen
        API->>API: Hash password using bcrypt
        API->>DB: INSERT user and KYC records
        activate DB
        DB-->>API: Records successfully written
        deactivate DB

        API-->>PWA: 201 Created + JWT token
        PWA-->>Worker: Display MicoPesa dashboard
    else Invalid citizen
        API-->>PWA: Registration rejected
        PWA-->>Worker: Display registration error
    end

    deactivate API
    deactivate PWA",
  "config": null
}

{
  "data": "---
title: MicoPesa - M-Pesa Contribution Sequence Diagram
---
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber

    actor Worker as Informal Worker
    participant PWA as React PWA
    participant API as Express Backend
    participant Daraja as Safaricom Daraja API
    participant DB as PostgreSQL Database
    participant Notify as Notification Service

    Worker->>PWA: Enter contribution amount
    activate PWA

    PWA->>API: POST /api/v1/contribute/stkpush
    activate API

    API->>Daraja: Initiate STK Push
    activate Daraja

    Daraja-->>API: CheckoutRequestID acknowledged
    deactivate Daraja

    API-->>PWA: STK Push initiated
    PWA-->>Worker: Display M-Pesa PIN prompt
    deactivate PWA

    Worker->>Daraja: Enter M-Pesa PIN
    activate Daraja

    Daraja->>API: Async webhook callback
    deactivate Daraja

    activate API

    alt Transaction successful
        API->>DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION
        activate DB

        API->>DB: Save transaction
        API->>DB: Save contribution
        API->>DB: Write audit log
        API->>DB: Update pension account balance

        DB-->>API: Transaction persisted
        deactivate DB

        API->>Notify: Send contribution confirmation
        activate Notify
        Notify-->>Worker: SMS / Push confirmation
        deactivate Notify

    else Transaction failed
        API->>Notify: Send transaction failure notification
        activate Notify
        Notify-->>Worker: SMS / Push failure message
        deactivate Notify
    end

    deactivate API",
  "config": null
}

{
  "data": "---
title: A Web-Based Micro-Pension Contribution Management and Savings Projection Platform - Clean ER Diagram
---
%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'themeVariables': {'background': '#ffffff'}}}%%
erDiagram
    direction LR

    %% USERS.role valid values: WORKER, FUND_MANAGER, REGULATOR, ADMIN
    %% Role boundaries enforced at the database layer:
    %%   - WITHDRAWAL_CLAIMS.reviewed_by must belong to a FUND_MANAGER user
    %%     (enforce_withdrawal_claim_reviewer_role trigger).
    %%   - COMPLIANCE_REPORTS.generated_by must belong to a FUND_MANAGER or
    %%     REGULATOR user (enforce_compliance_report_generator_role trigger).
    %%   - ADMIN is never a withdrawal-claim reviewer and never a
    %%     compliance-report generator; ADMIN manages USERS, SYSTEM_SETTINGS,
    %%     and originates administrative NOTIFICATIONS (created_by).

    USERS {
        VARCHAR_25 user_id PK
        VARCHAR_100 full_name
        VARCHAR_15 phone UK
        VARCHAR_255 password_hash
        VARCHAR_20 role
        VARCHAR_50 occupation
        VARCHAR_15 account_status
        DATE created_at
    }

    KYC_RECORDS {
        VARCHAR_25 kyc_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 user_id FK "UK"
        VARCHAR_25 national_id UK
        DATE date_of_birth
        VARCHAR_15 kyc_status
        DATE verified_at
    }

    PENSION_ACCOUNTS {
        VARCHAR_25 account_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 user_id FK "UK"
        REAL current_balance
        INTEGER retirement_age
        VARCHAR_15 account_status
        DATE created_at
    }

    FUNDS {
        VARCHAR_25 fund_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 managed_by FK
        VARCHAR_50 fund_name
        VARCHAR_50 administrator_name
        VARCHAR_15 risk_level
        REAL expected_return
        VARCHAR_15 fund_status
    }

    RETIREMENT_PLANS {
        VARCHAR_25 plan_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 account_id FK
        REAL target_amount
        INTEGER target_age
        REAL expected_return
        VARCHAR_20 contribution_frequency
        VARCHAR_15 plan_status
    }

    RETIREMENT_PROJECTIONS {
        VARCHAR_25 projection_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 plan_id FK
        REAL assumed_contribution
        REAL assumed_return
        REAL projected_amount
        INTEGER projection_years
        DATE projected_at
    }

    CONTRIBUTIONS {
        VARCHAR_25 contribution_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 account_id FK
        VARCHAR_25 transaction_id FK "UK"
        REAL amount
        VARCHAR_20 channel
        VARCHAR_15 contribution_status
        DATE created_at
    }

    TRANSACTIONS {
        VARCHAR_25 transaction_id PK
        VARCHAR_20 transaction_type
        REAL amount
        VARCHAR_25 mpesa_receipt UK
        VARCHAR_25 checkout_request_id UK
        VARCHAR_15 transaction_status
        DATE initiated_at
        DATE completed_at
    }

    WITHDRAWAL_CLAIMS {
        VARCHAR_25 claim_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 account_id FK
        VARCHAR_25 reviewed_by FK
        VARCHAR_25 transaction_id FK "UK"
        REAL amount_requested
        VARCHAR_15 destination_phone
        VARCHAR_15 claim_status
        DATE requested_at
        DATE reviewed_at
        DATE processed_at
    }

    FUND_ALLOCATIONS {
        VARCHAR_25 allocation_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 account_id FK
        VARCHAR_25 fund_id FK
        REAL percentage
        DATE effective_from
        DATE effective_to
    }

    NOTIFICATIONS {
        VARCHAR_25 notification_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 user_id FK
        VARCHAR_25 created_by FK "nullable"
        VARCHAR_20 notification_type
        VARCHAR_255 message
        VARCHAR_15 delivery_status
        DATE created_at
        DATE sent_at
    }

    USSD_SESSIONS {
        VARCHAR_25 session_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 user_id FK
        VARCHAR_15 phone
        VARCHAR_15 session_status
        DATE started_at
        DATE ended_at
    }

    AUDIT_LOGS {
        VARCHAR_25 log_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 user_id FK
        VARCHAR_20 action_type
        VARCHAR_50 entity_name
        VARCHAR_25 entity_id
        DATE timestamp
    }

    COMPLIANCE_REPORTS {
        VARCHAR_25 report_id PK
        VARCHAR_25 generated_by FK
        VARCHAR_20 report_type
        DATE period_start
        DATE period_end
        VARCHAR_15 rba_status
        DATE generated_at
    }

    SYSTEM_SETTINGS {
        VARCHAR_25 setting_id PK
        VARCHAR_100 setting_key UK
        VARCHAR_255 setting_value
        VARCHAR_255 description
        VARCHAR_25 updated_by FK "nullable"
        DATE updated_at
    }

    USERS ||--o| KYC_RECORDS : "verifies"
    USERS ||--o| PENSION_ACCOUNTS : "owns"
    USERS ||--o{ FUNDS : "manages"
    USERS ||--o{ NOTIFICATIONS : "receives"
    USERS o|--o{ NOTIFICATIONS : "creates"
    USERS ||--o{ USSD_SESSIONS : "performs"
    USERS ||--o{ AUDIT_LOGS : "generates"
    USERS ||--o{ COMPLIANCE_REPORTS : "generates"
    USERS o|--o{ WITHDRAWAL_CLAIMS : "reviews"

    PENSION_ACCOUNTS ||--o{ RETIREMENT_PLANS : "has"
    RETIREMENT_PLANS ||--o{ RETIREMENT_PROJECTIONS : "generates"
    PENSION_ACCOUNTS ||--o{ CONTRIBUTIONS : "receives"
    PENSION_ACCOUNTS ||--o{ WITHDRAWAL_CLAIMS : "submits"
    PENSION_ACCOUNTS ||--o{ FUND_ALLOCATIONS : "allocated_in"

    FUNDS ||--o{ FUND_ALLOCATIONS : "allocates"
    TRANSACTIONS ||--o| CONTRIBUTIONS : "settles"
    TRANSACTIONS ||--o| WITHDRAWAL_CLAIMS : "settles"
    USERS o|--o{ SYSTEM_SETTINGS : "updates"",
  "config": null
}
